'''August 2004 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held on 14 August 2004 at the Card Exchange (Aurora Card Exchange), 14020 Aurora N, Seattle, Washington, organized by [[Kyle Krueger]].<ref name="pcf-3725-50929">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50929#50929 Tournament in Seattle, August 14th], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213112/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52458%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-3725-51964">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51964#51964 Tournament in Seattle, August 14th], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213112/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52458%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was scheduled to start at 11:00 and to run six games.<ref name="pcf-3725-51712">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51712#51712 Tournament in Seattle, August 14th], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (31 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213112/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52458%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Six players took part.<ref name="pcf-3725-52723">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52723#52723 Tournament in Seattle, August 14th], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213112/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52458%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Card Exchange, 14020 Aurora N, Seattle, Washington<ref name="pcf-3725-51964" />
* '''Dates:''' 14 August 2004, 11:00<ref name="pcf-3725-50929" /><ref name="pcf-3725-51712" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Kyle Krueger]]<ref name="pcf-3725-51712" />
* '''Structure:''' six games<ref name="pcf-3725-51712" />
* '''Players:''' 6<ref name="pcf-3725-52723" />

Krueger offered ten packs of [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] as prizes if at least ten players came,<ref name="pcf-3725-51712" /> and said the entry fee would be decided at the event.<ref name="pcf-3725-52510">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52510#52510 Tournament in Seattle, August 14th], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905213112/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52458%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

Standings as posted by Krueger;<ref name="pcf-3725-52723" /> Aasen posted his own differential.<ref name="pcf-3725-52771" /> Prizes were packs of [[Reflections II]], about 12 for first, 8 for second, 6 for third, 5 for fourth and 2 each for fifth and sixth; Zach added five packs of [[Theed Palace]].<ref name="pcf-3725-52723" /> Aasen wrote that his Light Side deck won by 34 and 35 but that he built his Dark Side deck ten minutes before the tournament.<ref name="pcf-3725-52771" /> Afterwards Krueger wrote that he would run more tournaments in Seattle only if he could get at least ten players.<ref name="pcf-3725-53142">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=53142#53142 Tournament in Seattle, August 14th], Kyle Krueger, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (24 August 2004).
